items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: And I still had my management on Bill Davis and Bill Doggett.

ctx.x: Yeah, right. So Billy Shaw called me over. He'd lost a guy, and he wanted to hire me as an agent. And I wasn't too cool about being an agent, but I was really disgusted with my operation going on, because they just wasn't takin' care of business back here like I wanted it to be taken care of. Because we had a thing going. So he talked me... He talked a hole in my head. He said, "As long as you're a personal manager, you ain't nothin' but a flunky. You got to go and hang up the clothes.
